chunks: As for what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Ibn Sinān, from Ibn Muskān, who said: A trustworthy companion of mine narrated to me that he asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who comes upon a small amount of water on the road and wishes to perform ghusl, while he has no vessel with him, and the water is in a hollow; if he performs ghusl with it, the water from his washing returns into the water. How should he proceed?
He عليه السلام said: He should sprinkle with one handful in front of him, one handful behind him, one handful to his right, and one handful to his left, then perform ghusl.

So this does not contradict the earlier report, because it is possible that what is meant by ghusl here is other than ghusl al-janābah, among the recommended ghusls. For what is not permitted is the use of water with which ghusl has been performed when the ghusl is for janābah; but if it is recommended, then that takes the same ruling as wudu (ablution). It is also possible that this is specific to a state of necessity, and it must also be specific to one upon whose body there is nothing of najāsah, because if there were najāsah there, the water would become najis and its use would not be permitted in any case. And that which indicates that it is specifically for the state of necessity...

key_terms.النَّجَاسَةِ: ritual impurity whose presence would contaminate the water
key_terms.الِاضْطِرَارِ: a state of necessity or compulsion affecting the legal ruling
key_terms.الْأَغْسَالِ الْمَسْنُونَاتِ: recommended ghusls that are not obligatory
key_terms.الْمَاءِ الْقَلِيلِ: a small quantity of water subject to special fiqh rulings
key_terms.الْوُضُوءِ: wudu (ablution), used here as an analogy in legal ruling
key_terms.غُسْلِ الْجَنَابَةِ: the ghusl required due to the state of janābah

ai.seo_question: How should a person perform ghusl when only a small amount of water is available and the used water flows back into it?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling on performing ghusl with a small amount of water when the used water returns to its source. The Imam عليه السلام instructs a method of sprinkling around oneself before washing, and the compiler explains that the report may concern a recommended ghusl or a case of necessity, not necessarily ghusl al-janābah.
